one_line: A young Meitei defender of the Manipur valley during the Seven Years Devastation (1819–1826 CE), caught between Burmese occupation and princely struggles.

appearance.age_look: early 20s, lean and wiry with a runner’s build and hardened soldier’s posture
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown complexion, straight nose, sharp dark-brown eyes with thick brows, a faint scar on the left cheek, default expression calm but watchful with a quiet, determined intensity
appearance.hair: straight, black hair tied into a high topknot at the back of the crown, sides and back neatly trimmed short, with a narrow white cotton headband wrapped low across the forehead and knotted at the back, ends tucked in
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length white cotton pheijom (dhoti-style wrap) tightly wound and pleated in front with a clean straight hem just below the knees, paired with a fitted, long-sleeved off-white cotton jacket that closes left-over-right with small cloth ties and reaches to mid-hip; over this he drapes a light but coarse-weave, unbleached cotton shawl (phanek-like upper cloth) edged with a thin red border, worn diagonally from left shoulder to right hip and often wrapped around the torso when at rest; his legs are bare below the pheijom but he wears simple dark-brown leather sandals with toe straps; a narrow red cotton waistband is visible above the pheijom knot, and a small cloth pouch hangs from it at his right hip; jewellery is minimal—just a single thin bronze bangle on his right wrist and small plain brass ear-studs—keeping the overall look practical, modest, and era-appropriate for a Meitei commoner-soldier displaced between Kangla, Cachar, and the Ava frontier.
appearance.signature: A slender, slightly curved single-edged dha-style sword with a plain iron blade about forearm-length, a simple wooden hilt bound in dark-brown cord, and a narrow wooden scabbard stained deep brown, carried slung diagonally across his back with a rough, undyed cotton strap.

ref_desc: Khuman Ngamba is a lean early-twenties Meitei man with a scarred oval face, black topknot with white headband, wearing a white pheijom, off-white tied jacket, diagonal beige shawl with red border, bronze bangle, and a brown-hilted dha sword in a dark wooden back-scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Khuman Ngamba, a lean early-twenties Meitei man with an oval medium-brown face, high cheekbones, sharp dark-brown eyes, and a faint scar on his left cheek, his straight black hair tied in a high topknot with a narrow white cotton headband across his forehead; dress him in an era-accurate early-19th-century Meitei outfit: a knee-length white cotton pheijom (dhoti wrap) neatly pleated in front, a fitted long-sleeved off-white cotton jacket closing left-over-right with cloth ties to mid-hip, and a light unbleached cotton shawl with a thin deep-red border draped diagonally from left shoulder to right hip, sometimes wrapped closer around his torso, plus a narrow red cotton waistband peeking above the pheijom knot, a small cloth pouch at his right hip, simple dark-brown leather sandals, a thin bronze bangle on his right wrist, and small plain brass ear-studs; on his back, show his slender, slightly curved dha-style sword with a plain iron blade and dark-brown cord-wrapped wooden hilt in a deep-brown wooden scabbard on an undyed cotton strap; use a palette of off-white, unbleached beige, deep red, dark brown, and bronze, and present him front, side, and back, highlighting his calm, watchful, determined expression and consistent costume details.
